description: This Java class defines the TbResourceInfo data model, including fields, constructors, and methods for resource metadata management within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbResourceInfo
classes.description: A data class representing resource information with metadata such as title, type, key, and descriptor, supporting JSON serialization and resource link generation.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates the resource URL based on type and tenant.

methods.name: getPublicLink
methods.description: Generates the public URL if resource is public and of type IMAGE.

methods.name: getSearchText
methods.description: Returns the search text, same as title.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Deserializes the descriptor JSON into specified class.

methods.name: updateDescriptor
methods.description: Updates the descriptor using a provided updater function.

methods.name: setDescriptorValue
methods.description: Sets the descriptor JSON from an object.
